revenue_rule: raw current-month revenue / same-month-prior-year > prior contiguous month's same ratio; both positive denominators and nonnegative revenue
revenue_available: first market day strictly after month_end+lag; latest month only; age>100 days unknown
flow_rule: each of prior five market days institutional total_net >0; source row absent on any day => unknown; signal-day report excluded
price_rule: close > prior60 max close and volume >1.5 * prior20 mean, as frozen earlier
common_pool: finite as-of existing seven price features, price rule, revenue rule, and five-day institutional rule; future labels do not filter pool
costs: unchanged existing commission .001425, sell_tax .003, each-side slippage .005
limitations: retrospective static monthly snapshots are not strict first-publication PIT; report separate from original models
